hero_text: From gas processing and CNG compression to refuelling and power generation, Pulita designs, builds and supports the whole chain, with real installations working across Nigeria.
products_title: Everything between the gas and the kilowatt.
products_text: Generators first, then the stations and equipment that keep them fuelled. One manufacturer, one point of accountability.
line1_text: Generator sets from 15 to 2,500 kVA that run on the gas you have, cutting fuel costs by up to 77% compared with diesel.
line2_text: Skid-mounted CNG refilling stations and mobile refuelling units (MRUs) with hydraulic compressors that bring CNG to vehicles, buses, trucks and generators, with no pipeline needed.
line3_text: Pipeline-fed compression stations that fill tube trailers and cascades to supply a network of daughter stations and gas-powered sites.
line4_text: LNG is stored on site and converted to CNG, bringing natural gas to stations and sites far from any pipeline.
